lead: Sharad Pawar has built a public profile as an Indian politician, born on 12 December 1940 in Pune.
As of 2026, he is 85 years old, and his birth date places him under the Sagittarius sign.

He has held the office of Member of Maharashtra Legislative Assembly and Chief Minister of Maharashtra and has been recognised with Padma Vibhushan in Public Affairs and Outstanding Parliamentarian Award.
This profile collects the Sharad facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Sharad Pawar — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Sharad Pawar was born on 12 December 1940 in Pune, and holds citizenship of India, British Raj and Dominion of India.
Public records name his father, Govindrao Pawar. He is a sibling of Anantrao Pawar.

sections.heading: Sharad Pawar — Career and Professional Work
paras: Sharad Pawar works primarily as a politician.

He has held the following offices: Member of Maharashtra Legislative Assembly, Chief Minister of Maharashtra (1978–1980), member of Rajya Sabha (2014–present), Minister of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution (2004–2011), Minister of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare (2004–2014) and Member of the 13th Lok Sabha. He is affiliated with Indian National Congress.
